## Chillscreen: smoother, calmer, tidier
- **No more stutter:** fewer lights, shadows only redrawn when something moves, all shaders prepared up front (the first transition no longer hitches), a lower render size on phones, frames capped at 60 per second and the quality adjusts itself on slow devices
- **Calmer transitions:** only glide, cut, fade, fade through black and a soft drift are left
- **On the beat is instant:** with "Transitions on the beat" turned on, the shot changes right on the beat with a hard cut or a very short fade
- **Tidier deck:** power, start/stop, 33/45 sit in one row at the front, the display and the ±8/±16 buttons at the front right, the pitch fader along the right edge. The dot matrix on the front is gone, the dot ring around the platter stays
- **Real CD cases:** clear jewel cases with a black tray and a printed spine; the loose CD lies flat on the sideboard
- **Record shelf with real covers:** one compartment with a full row, one with a pile lying flat, one half full with leaning records, one with a record face out
- **Fixes:** the bean bag sits on the floor, plant soil no longer flickers, the guitar and the big plants keep clear of the wall, and on phones the camera no longer ends up inside a plant

The room on the website got the same update.

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
